purpose: Credential risk register for active app identities
scope_limitation: Credential expiry data (secret/certificate expiration dates) requires Microsoft Graph API access to app registrations. This register is constructed from available evidence; a full credential audit requires direct Graph query of each app registration's passwordCredentials and keyCredentials.
known_risks_note: No specific expired or soon-expiring credentials were identified during MAINT-01 evidence collection. Graph API was used for high-level enumeration (count: 112 app registrations) but individual credential expiry dates were not extracted.

risk_classes.P0: Expired credential on a production workload causing active failure — NONE IDENTIFIED
risk_classes.P1: Credential expiring within 30 days on a production workload — NONE IDENTIFIED
risk_classes.P2: Credential expiring within 90 days — NONE IDENTIFIED
risk_classes.P3: Password-based workload identity that should be migrated to federation or managed identity — POTENTIAL but not quantified

recommended_follow_up.query: GET /applications?$select=displayName,passwordCredentials,keyCredentials — filter on endDateTime < 90 days from now
recommended_follow_up.priority: Wave 1 prerequisite — should be completed before other waves proceed
recommended_follow_up.risk_if_not_done: A secret or certificate expiry on a production GitHub Actions workflow, Power Automate connector, or Copilot Studio agent could cause silent failure

github_oidc_health.status: No expiry risk — OIDC federated credentials are token-based and do not expire in the same way as secrets

classification: INCOMPLETE — credential expiry sweep required in Wave 1 before authoritative P0/P1 assessment
